comments.content: First principles: Trade barriers only delay the inevitable evolution of technology. Protectionism is a bug, not a feature. If we want to reach Mars, we need more trust, not less. Semiconductor bottlenecks are just a lack of physics-based optimization. Interesting. 🚀
